# `deform.twist`: Twist

Twists a shape around an axis, from no turn at its low end to `angle` at its high end.

- Category: deform
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(k log k) for k vertices
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: twist, simple deform twist, nonlinear twist

Vertices rotate around the axis line through the object origin, by an amount growing linearly along the axis. Needs segments along the axis to look smooth.

**Use for** twisted columns, drill bits, ropes, horns, stylized tree trunks.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | `Angle` | `90.0` | Turn at the far end (degrees; the low end stays). |
| `axis` | `AxisParam` | `"y"` | Axis to twist around (through the object origin). |
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Vertices to twist (edges and faces select theirs); all when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"angle":180,"target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3): twisted 34 vertices around Y by 180 degrees`
